_comment: Mission Pathways (core/pathway_manager.py). Hand-edited directly -- add more pathways or steps without touching any code. Each pathway trains one primary skill_id (must exist in data/skill_definitions.json); each step's skill_rewards can name other skills too, for real cross-training. Steps are plain Missions (no auto-tracked objectives) -- the user marks each complete once they've genuinely done the real-world thing, same as any other Mission.

pathways.name: Carpentry Fundamentals
pathways.description: Three real builds that take you from first cuts to framing a wall.

steps.name: Build a Birdhouse
steps.summary: A small, low-stakes first project to practice measuring, cutting, and assembling.

steps.name: Build a Garden Bed
steps.summary: A raised bed teaches square corners and real outdoor-lumber joinery -- and feeds the homestead too.

steps.name: Frame a Small Wall Section
steps.summary: Studs, plates, and real structural framing -- the first genuine step toward building a room.

pathways.name: Backyard Growing
pathways.description: From a seed tray to your first real harvest.

steps.name: Start a Seed Tray
steps.summary: Get something real growing -- the first step of any garden.

steps.name: Prepare a Garden Bed
steps.summary: Real soil work -- testing, amending, and preparing ground worth planting in.

steps.name: Harvest Your First Crop
steps.summary: The real payoff -- something you grew, ready to eat.

pathways.name: Foundational Strength
pathways.description: Build a real, sustained workout habit and hit a genuine milestone.

steps.name: Complete Your First Full Workout
steps.summary: One real session, start to finish -- everything else builds from here.

steps.name: Log 5 Workout Sessions
steps.summary: Consistency over any single session -- five real workouts logged.

steps.name: Set a New Personal Record
steps.summary: Real, measurable progress -- beat a number you've actually logged before.

pathways.name: Kitchen Explorer
pathways.description: From one new recipe to cooking for someone else.

steps.name: Cook a New Recipe
steps.summary: Something you haven't made before -- real practice, not a repeat.

steps.name: Cook 5 Different Meals This Month
steps.summary: Real variety in the kitchen, not the same three meals on repeat.

steps.name: Host a Meal for Someone Else
steps.summary: Cooking for someone else raises the bar -- and it's real hospitality practice too.
